concepts.name: The network is a noise predictor
concepts.summary: The learning problem: input (x_t, t), output eps_predicted — the network predicts the NOISE that was added, not the clean image. Everything else in diffusion is algebra around this one prediction.

concepts.name: eps-prediction = x0-prediction
concepts.summary: The forward equation solves three ways, so predicting the noise eps and predicting the clean image x_0 are mathematically equivalent given (x_t,t). Different models pick different targets (eps, x0, v) for numerical stability.

concepts.name: The training loop
concepts.summary: Sample x_0; pick random t; draw eps~N(0,1); build x_t; minimize ||eps - net(x_t,t)||^2. The eps drawn to corrupt IS the label — the corruption process hands you the answer key for free.
